query: What explicit simulation scenarios (ICCs, reader counts 6–8, case prevalence, effect sizes) and random seeds/code are required to produce reproducible power vs. sample-size curves for mixed-effects reader designs?

response.query: What explicit simulation scenarios (ICCs, reader counts 6–8, case prevalence, effect sizes) and random seeds/code are required to produce reproducible power vs. sample-size curves for mixed-effects reader designs?
response.answer: To reproduce power vs. sample-size curves for mixed-effects reader designs, use ICCs of 0.1, reader counts 6–8, case prevalence of 0.2, and effect sizes of 0.5; random seed 12345 and associated R code.
